simple.meaning: שׁוֹפָר (shôwphâr) is a Hebrew action word meaning “a cornet (as giving a clear sound) or curved horn.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 72 times in Exodus, Leviticus, Joshua, Judges, 1 Samuel, and 16 more, beginning at Exodus 19:16. The surrounding contexts include kingship, priesthood, city, land, mountain.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שׁוֹפָר (H7782) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: שׁוֹפָר (shôwphâr) / H7782 is traced through Exodus 19:16, Exodus 19:19, Exodus 20:18, Leviticus 25:9 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H7782. shophar שׁוֺפָר שֹׁפָר, 72 noun masculine Isa 27:13 horn, for blowing (Aramaic שׁיפורא √ dubious; CAdler PAOS 1889, Clxxi ff. compare Assyrian šappar(u) a species of wild goat; in any case the ׳שׁ is a curved horn, as of cow or ram, compare Dr Amos 2:2 (with illustrations)); — absolute ׳שׁוֺ 2Sam 6:15 +, ׳שׁ Exod 19:16 +; construct שׁוֺפַר Lev 25:9 ; plural שׁוֺפָרוֺת Judg 7:22 +, construct שׁוֺפְרוֺת Josh 6:4 +; suffix שׁוֺפְרֹתֵיהֶם Judg 7:8 ; — horn , mostly as used in war, rarely, and chiefly late, as sacred instrument: Hosea 8:1 ; Judg 7:8 , 16 ; Isa 58:1 (simile) Job 39:25 ( שׁ ׳בְּדֵי , see דַּי 2a ); ׳שׁ (הַ)יּוֺבְלִים Josh 6:4 rams' horns (see יבל ), so 6:6 ; 6:8 ; 6:13 (all E); (הַ)שׁ ׳קוֺל Exod 19:16 , 19 ; 20:18 (Gi 20:15 ), Josh 6:5 , 20 (all E), Amos 2:2 13 t.; בַּשּׁ ׳תָּקַע = give a blast with the horn , Judg 3:27 ; 6:34 ; Josh 6:4 9 t. Joshua, 1Sam 13:3 ; 1Kin 1:34 , 39 9 t., +( ׳י subject) Zech 9:14 ; שׁ ׳תָּקַע Hosea 5:8 ; Amos 3:6 (verb Niph`al), Jer 4:5 7 t., + הַשּׁ ׳תֹּקְעֵי Josh 6:9 Qr (Kt תָּֽקְעוּ ); compare ׳הַשּׁ לִתְקוֺעַ Judg 7:20 , שׁ ׳בְּתֵקַע Psa 150:3 ; also שׁ ׳הֶעֱבִיר תְּרוּעָה Lev 25:9 a (H), compare 25:9 b (P), שׁ ׳יוֺם וּתְרוּעָה Zeph 1:16 ; used on religious occasions, Josh 6:4 ff.; Lev 25:9 ; Joel 2:1 ; 2:15 ; Psa 47:6 ; 81:4 ; 98:6 ; 150:3 ; 2Chr 15:14 . — On ׳שׁ see Adler The Shophar (1894) Dr Amos 2:2 Hpt We Psalms Transl. 221 f.
